evidence_scope: Sanitized immutable v5_engineering_006_task_boundary evidence; no task instructions, histories, scorer state, prompts, or provider responses are included.
old_mutation_sequence: score artifacts and retrieval artifacts became durable
apply_task_batch selected/promoted a winner and mutated the live adapter
task state and marker were persisted
first_invalid_mutation: apply_task_batch in complete_copro_task, before the A acceptance gate
gate_predicate_bug: The old task_boundary_v6 gate required event.observed and not event.check. Normalized observed AppWorld API responses intentionally set check='API response observed', making the predicate reject evidence it simultaneously required.

reconstruction_findings.prior_offline_mismatch: The report-only reconstruction passed normalized events positionally as RawAcquisitionTrajectory.handoffs instead of events; this yielded an empty event sequence. It did not alter the immutable live state.
prevented_by_repair: canonical state and marker reconstruction share commit_task_boundary_plan
trials are canonically sorted by task_id, seed, trajectory_index
all IDs derive from canonical event/episode content
input state is JSON-cloned before planning
candidate-only audit state is never used as a retrieval bank

repaired_006_counterfactual.corrected_gate_interpretation: The stored A histories normalize to 7 and 8 observed structurally valid events. The recorded false fully_observed result is attributable to the gate-predicate bug, not a reconstruction mismatch.
repaired_006_counterfactual.commit_rule: A future run may commit only after the pure plan validation passes; this audit does not retroactively validate or alter 006.
